newsitem.title: FINLAND: TELIVO'S 96 PROFIT FALLS 7 PCT TO FIM 6.9 MLN.
newsitem.headline: TELIVO'S 96 PROFIT FALLS 7 PCT TO FIM 6.9 MLN.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications operator Telivo Oy, owned by Swedish telecoms group Telia, said on Friday its 1996 profit after financial items fell to 6.9 million markka from 7.4 million the year before.
Telivo said turnover increased to 138.8 million markka last year from 109 million in 1995.
Overseas calls accounted for about 60 percent of turnover, while domestic calls were 20 percent.
Telivo said it aims to start mobile phone operations in 1997.
"There will be big investments in the new business sector as Finland is the world's leading country in mobile phones," it said.
Telivo said it expected net sales to grow "substantially" this year.
Sweden's state-owned telecoms operator Telia has 75 percent of Telivo and Finnish power group Imatran Voima (IVO) owns 25 percent.
